instruction: Look up available one-way flights from Milan to Lisbon for a single adult on the 12th of the upcoming month.

metadata.explanation: Task variation 3: Search for one-way flight from Milan Bergamo (BGY) to Lisbon (LIS) for 1 adult on 12th of next month. Uses existing evaluator functions to verify URL parameters. Maintains same complexity and interaction pattern as original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts URL parameters from active Chrome tab to verify flight search
Complete coverage: checks all instruction requirements (origin BGY, destination LIS, 1 adult, 0 teens/children, one-way, date 12th next month)
Correct semantic mapping: BGY is Milan Bergamo (Ryanair's main Milan airport), LIS is Lisbon airport code
Relative time handling is correct: 'rule_relativeTime' properly converts '12th next month' to absolute date format at evaluation time
Data flow is sound: getter extracts URL params → metric compares exact match → expected values are semantically correct
Minor issue: no postconfig to ensure browser stays on search results page, but acceptable for snapshot-based evaluation
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding postconfig to ensure Chrome remains on the search results page after agent completes task
Consider adding tolerance for URL parameter variations (e.g., if Ryanair omits tpTeens/tpChildren when zero rather than explicitly setting them to '0')
